question: Which is ninth among the pithas, and who is chief?
premises: confluence Varuna agitated-mountain tower-laughter Jayanti and the rest
in the middle — and chief of them the wheel-bearer
inference: Nine pithas culminate in the golden city; the wheel-bearer is chief.
plain_english: Confluence Varuna agitated-mountain tower-laughter Jayanti and the rest — golden city ninth, in the middle; and chief of them the wheel-bearer.
